class.name: GameplayAttributeSet
class.brief_description: Provides live access to one attribute set assigned to an actor.
class.description: Get this view from [method AbilitySystemComponent.get_attribute_set]. Refer to attributes by their local IDs, such as [code]health[/code] in the [code]main_set[/code] set. The component owns access to live values. The view cannot access them after the component is freed or its match retires.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the authored ID of this set.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description: Returns a detached reading for local [param attribute_id]. Returns null for an unknown ID, an unavailable source, or a value outside the recipient's visibility.

method.name: set_base
method.description: Replaces the base of local [param attribute_id] with finite [param value], in the attribute's units. Returns [code]OK[/code] when the source accepts the edit. Returns a Godot error when the ID, value, or authority is invalid, or when the source cannot commit.

method.name: add_base
method.description: Adds finite [param delta], in the attribute's units, to the base of local [param attribute_id]. Returns [code]OK[/code] on success or a Godot error when the edit is rejected or the result is non-finite.

method.name: watch_attribute
method.description: Creates a watch for local [param attribute_id]. Returns null when the ID is empty or uses a qualified set prefix. Retain the watch while listening for confirmed readings.
